select count(1) from Sec_Win_Unit_Member wum
1=1
and wum.Wn_Id=#{params.wnId}
and wum.Wum_Education=#{params.wumEducation}
and wum.Wum_Name like concat('%',#{params.wumName},'%')
and wum.Wum_Mobile_Phone like concat('%',#{params.wumMobilePhone},'%')
and wum.Wum_Social_Security_Num like concat('%',#{params.wumSocialSecurityNum},'%')
and wum.Wum_Certificate_Num like concat('%',#{params.wumCertificateNum},'%')
and wum.Wum_Id_Card like concat('%',#{params.wumIdCard},'%')
